name: What considerations should I make when choosing finishes for a powder room?

mainEntity.name: What considerations should I make when choosing finishes for a powder room?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing finishes for a powder room, consider both durability and design impact. Given its frequent use by guests, selecting durable, easy-to-clean materials for flooring, countertops, and fixtures is practical. However, it's also an opportunity to be bold with design choices, as it's a small space where unique elements can truly shine without overwhelming the home. Our designers can guide you through material selections, from custom vanities to unique lighting, ensuring every choice contributes to a spa-inspired experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing finishes for a powder room, prioritize durability and design impact. Select easy-to-clean materials, and consider bold design choices to make the small space distinctive.
